title: Aura's Better Movement
description: Minecraft's movement kinda sucks. This mod spices up movement with a bunch of new abilities!
body:
Minecraft's movement, frankly, is kinda lame.

Inspired by a movement shooter that I'm actively developing, **Aura's Better Movement** is here to fix that! (or at least make it feel a lot less like you're piloting a very heavy shopping cart through molasses)

---

## The Abilities

All abilities are disabled while you're in water or lava. No aquatic parkour (for now). Learn the basics first, then chain them together.

### Aerodynamics

Hold **Sprint** while airborne to gradually accelerate in the direction you're looking. It's subtle, but it adds up, especially during a wavedash boost (see below), when you get a **3× speed multiplier**.

---

### Dash

**How:** While in the air, press **Sneak** to dash in the direction you're looking.

**Cooldown:** 2 seconds. A small icon below your crosshair fills back up when Dash is ready.

**Tip:** Hold **Back** while dashing to dash *backward* instead. Great for dramatic exits.

---

### Double Jump

**How:** Leave the ground, then jump again in mid-air. You can trigger it two ways:

1. **Release and re-press Jump** after leaving the ground, or
2. **Fall at least 2 blocks** from where you left the ground, then press Jump.

**Resource meter:** Double jump uses a charge that recharges over time (~4 seconds for a full refill). Each jump costs half a bar. An icon below the crosshair shows your remaining charge.

---

### Wavedash

**How:** Dash in the air, then **land while looking down** (roughly 60° or more, basically, stare at your feet like you dropped something). If you land within a short window after dashing, you trigger a **wavedash boost** for about 3 seconds.

**What it does:**

- Your crosshair changes to indicate the boost is active.
- **Aerodynamics** gets a 3× multiplier. You will go *fast*.
- **Glide** becomes available (see below).

**Sound cue:** You'll hear a distinct activation sound when it works. If you hear nothing, you mistimed it. Happens to everyone.

**Tip:** Dash -> look down -> land. Practice on flat ground before you try it over a ravine.

---

### Glide

**How:** While your **wavedash boost is active** and you've recently used your double jump, press **Jump** in the air to start gliding.

**What it does:** You accelerate horizontally in your current movement direction (not where you're looking, where you're *going*). You also get a small upward nudge. Your crosshair changes while gliding.

**To stop:** Land, start elytra flying, touch water, or let go of Jump for more than a few ticks.

**Tip:** The full combo is the real flex: **Dash -> Wavedash -> Double Jump → Glide**. String it together and it'll feel like a completely different game.

---

## HUD Cheatsheet

| Indicator | Location | Meaning |
|-----------|----------|---------|
| Dash icon | Below crosshair | Dash cooldown (fills when ready) |
| Double jump icon | Below dash icon | Air jump charge (fills when ready) |
| Wavedash crosshair | Center of screen | Wavedash boost is active |
| Glide crosshair | Center of screen | Currently gliding |

If you hear cloud poofs and whoosh sounds, you're probably doing it right.

---

## Disclaimers and Stuff

This mod has **zero** progression. You are given the abilities straight off the bat. I'm planning on working on some sort of system, but it doesn't exist right now. 

There is **no way** to toggle the abilities off. I cannnnn fix this, but like, why?

A lot of the logic is processed clientside with serverside *validation* only, since there were a lot of issues with my packet registry (namely that I have no idea what I'm doing), so you may come into a lot of issues with desync between client and server, *especially* when taking damage. There's unfortunately not much I can do about that right now.
